description: CoreWeave IP address ranges, from the prefixes announced by the autonomous systems held by CoreWeave, Inc (AS33425, AS46992) as reported by the RIPEstat Data API. This is general-purpose rented compute: the tenant behind any given address changes constantly and an attacker can simply rent one. The list recognises that an address belongs to the provider; it is NOT grounds for treating traffic as benign.
name: List of known CoreWeave IP address ranges
